headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an overall effect size of 0.64 (95% CI: 0.43–0.95), suggesting that legumes is associated with a lower risk of bladder cancer. However, this association should be interpreted with caution, as there was very high between-study heterogeneity (I² = 77.91%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
